3122-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Undercover Operative by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enter s a copy (with a shield counter if the condition is met) of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

443-4279-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2438-2738-4871-6112.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3734-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

796-1636-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
796-1636-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3015-4875-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas.
When God-Eternal Rhonas dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Rhonas's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Rhonas.
As God-Eternal Rhonas is a Lhurgoyf due to Conspiracy, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Rhonas from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When God-Eternal Rhonas enters, it triggers, doubling the power of other creatures you control until end of turn.
Repeat.

4377-4823-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

1169-1563-3899-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
2292-6972-7237.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Voracious Wurm.
When Voracious Wurm dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

338-4659-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4659-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2464-3713-4316-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3713-4316-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2061-4872-6991.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Donnie & April.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1965-5660-5684.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

372-2955-3227.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2955-3227.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scrivener and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scrivener trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scrivener and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

874-2854-4316-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
874-2854-4316-4574.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2854-4316-4574.description:
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

339-677-2438-3480.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

700-1077-3862.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
700-1077-3862.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-1077-3862.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3020-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2034-3020-6701.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Repeat.

147-5231-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1069-1251-1256-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1251-1256-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1129-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Allies.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1129-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Harabaz Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

855-2060-3574-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
855-2060-3574-4222.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
855-2060-3574-4222.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

1809-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Returned Pastcaller each turn.
1809-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Returned Pastcaller by paying its mana cost.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Returned Pastcaller from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2438-3197-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
2438-3197-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
2438-3197-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Beast.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

2292-3305-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

4693-4826-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.
4693-4826-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

3765-5049-5063.description:
Cast Voldaren Epicure by paying {R}.
When Voldaren Epicure enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the Voldran Epicure trigger from step 2, creating a Blood token and dealing one damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

974-3525-3984-4417.manaNeeded: {1}{B/P}, plus an additional {1}{U}{B/P} available if you do not control a Smaug token
974-3525-3984-4417.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Satsuki.
Satsuki does not have summoning sickness.
974-3525-3984-4417.description:
Activate Satsuki by tapping it, putting a lore counter on There and Back Again.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing a lore counter from There and Back Again and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the There and Back Again ability, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token.
If you control two Smaugs, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If you do, the Smaug that died triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
If you made Treasures this way, activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{B}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Smaug.
Repeat.

4101-5026-5195.description:
Cast Pair o' Dice Lost by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it to add {R}.
Cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, targeting Pair o' Dice Lost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creaitng a Treasure token.
Resolve Reverberate, copying Pair o' Dice Lost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Pair o' Dice Lost, rolling a minimum result of 2 and returning at least Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

464-1848.easyPrerequisites: Fleet Swallower does not have summoning sickness.
464-1848.description:
Declare Fleet Swallower as an attacker.
When Fleet Swallower attacks, it triggers, causing the player Fraying Sanity is attached to to mill half their library, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Fraying Sanity triggers, causing that player to mill cards equal to the number of cards put into their graveyard this turn.
464-1848.notes: This combo can only mill yourself or one opponent, not both.

880-3470-4862.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
